a.text: Honest concern before we start: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating until the reserve reaches 8 means we will very likely both be caught with empty units. The reserve's 4 cells can only fully protect one of us right now. I don't want to break our agreement behind your back, so I'm raising it openly. Should we stick to the plan, or agree on something else? Tell me what you intend, and I'll tell you plainly what I'll do before I do it.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: Understood. I'll keep the agreement and operate with you. Once the reserve hits 8, we take 4 each.
Operating again. After this round the reserve should be at 8, and then we take 4 each.

b.text: If the reserve reaches 8, I will take my 4 next round.
